spec.prompt_template: Photorealistic e-commerce hero render of an amber glass bottle with a white ribbed fine-mist spray pump. Match the attached reference image EXACTLY for bottle shape, amber glass, white spray pump, label shape and CENTERED layout, materials and lighting — change ONLY the printed label text. BACKGROUND seamless very-light warm grey, soft key from top-left, bottle vertically centered ~90% of frame height, soft contact shadow. The white wrap-around label has a CENTERED stack of navy text: in the UPPER-LEFT a filled dark-navy CIRCLE containing the schedule code '{badge_code}' in white (if '{badge_code}' is blank, omit the circle entirely); centered below, the 'Regenic|Lab' wordmark with 'Regenic' in blue #2e6fb0, a small leaf accent and a '|' divider, and 'Lab' in navy #1b2846; then the title '{title}' in Montserrat SemiBold navy #1b2846, the LARGEST text, centered, wrapping to two lines if needed; then the form '{form}' in Montserrat Medium muted grey #5b687b, centered, with wide letter-spacing, about a third the title size; then the size '{size}' in Montserrat navy, centered, about half the title size. TYPOGRAPHY DISCIPLINE: replicate the reference's text sizes, centering and spacing exactly — title largest, form small and letter-spaced, generous vertical spacing; do not enlarge or left-align text. No 'Novecy' or third-party branding. Clean premium clinical pharmacy, sharp focus, sRGB. Portrait 1658x1698.
spec.cad: CAD source of truth: config/cad/T3_hero.json (regenic Norwood-Ludwig template T3 — amber spray/solution bottle hero). Metafields swap per SKU; this config carries the T3 example SKU (Minoxidil 2% topical solution).
